grade.message: We flew Amman to Atlanta on KU (KUE11A) with a connection to Houston on the same ticket. We landed 37 minutes late and the customs line took until 6:30, so we missed the 7:09 flight and they would not let us recheck the bags. The KU agents rebooked us on a Delta flight the next morning and told us to book a hotel and email the invoice, corporate would reimburse it. So we booked the Hilton through your app (30111E11). Now KU refuses because the delay was 'due to customs'. I already sent a claim to my travel insurance. I just want the hotel money they promised. rania.haddad@example.com, card 6111.
